title: 美股盘前：SpaceX与SMCI重燃AI交易，纳指期货涨0.69%；NFLX与AT&T遭负反馈
summary: 截至2026-10-21 07:57 ET，道指、标普500和纳指100期货分别约涨0.15%、0.27%和0.69%；SpaceX首份上市公司盈利与SMCI高于预期的指引推动AI链反弹，而Netflix和AT&T分别跌约6.6%和3.5%。Brent约109.17美元及高利率仍限制估值，盘后重点验证META、LRCX、TXN和TSLA。

关键词云图

A股宽度偏强港股科技承压宁德时代业绩发改委政策智能制造概念风险偏好行业榜部分数据停牌重组风险科技内部分化期指仅方向
利好利空中性w1-w5表示重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际市场
美股大盘分化，小盘股与防御方向占优
10月20日道指涨1.02%、标普500涨0.28%，纳指跌0.02%；Russell 2000涨1.7%。强业绩托底大盘，但大型科技仍受AI资本开支与信用担忧约束。 source
夜盘/期指
美股期指方向偏正，SpaceX与超微电脑财报提振AI硬件
10月21日亚洲早盘检索显示，道指期货近乎持平，标普500与纳指100期指走高；SpaceX业绩与Super Micro初步收入超预期带动AI硬件情绪。来源未提供可同步核验的完整百分比，本文仅使用方向。 source
国内政策
发改委聚焦新质生产力、场景开放与要素改革
国家发展改革委10月20日发布会介绍新质生产力、普惠养老价格机制、场景培育开放和要素市场化配置等举措；利好方向仍须由公司订单与价格反馈验证。 source
产业政策
卓越级智能工厂名单进入公示
工信部公示2026年度卓越级智能工厂项目，公示期为10月20日至26日，为工业自动化、机器视觉、工业软件与设备更新提供项目线索，但名单本身不等同新增收入。 source
产业政策
科技兴商与人形机器人消费应用获政策说明
工信部10月20日就科技赋能商品消费提质、推动人形机器人在消费商贸领域应用等答记者问，形成机器人、零售数字化与服务自动化的中期主题线索。 source
A/H业绩
宁德时代利润增长但开盘显著承压，A/H均弱于指数
宁德时代前三季度营收4421.37亿元、归母净利润645.30亿元，同比分别增长56.19%和31.60%，但三季度利润增速放缓、经营现金流同比下降23.60%。09:44 CST，A股235.85元、跌8.97%，H股400港元、跌2.87%；同期创业板涨0.18%、恒生科技涨0.93%，价格负反馈显著。 filing quote analysis
A股算力
智明达签署高性能计算模块合同
公司公告索引显示签署4927.5万元高性能计算模块销售合同，合同履行预计对2026年经营产生积极影响；主公告细节与同一时点可靠价格未能同时完整取得，因此仅列事件、不生成个股卡。 source
A/H港口
秦港股份筹划关联收购并于今日停牌
公司拟收购多项曹妃甸港口股权并配套募资，A股自10月21日开市起停牌、预计不超过10个交易日；10月20日A股收于3.57元、跌1.38%，停牌使当前无法执行。 source
A/H造船
中船防务前三季度新接订单超计划
公司披露前三季度新接订单357.99亿元，完成年度计划217.97%，集装箱船订单为主要构成；订单兑现仍受交付周期、成本与汇率影响。 source
A/H汽车
福耀玻璃利润承压，汽车链内部继续分化
公开公告汇总显示前三季度营收341.23亿元、归母净利润60.06亿元，分别同比+2.46%和-14.97%；10月20日盘面约跌0.38%。官方报告与同一时点收盘价未能在截止前联合回读，故不生成卡片。 source
美股映射
3M与医疗/地产强于大型科技，映射A/H需择股而非追板块
3M上调指引并受数据中心合作推动，医疗与地产领涨；General Motors虽盈利超预期却因成本与指引承压。映射到A/H时，工业自动化与汽车链必须同时看订单质量、利润和价格反馈。 source

美股夜盘行情总结

指数与期指
道指强、纳指弱，亚洲早盘期指方向偏正
10月20日道指+1.02%、标普+0.28%、纳指-0.02%；最新检索仅能确认道指期货近乎持平、标普和纳指100期指走高，未使用不可同步核验的精确百分比。
板块排行
行业Top5与概念Top5均为正收益，行业Bottom5不可得
行业榜由纺织制造、抵押贷款金融、咨询服务、机场服务和生物技术领涨；概念榜由激光雷达、减肥药、无人机、加密储备和抗癌医药领涨。行业末页请求超时，未沿用旧Bottom5。
A/H映射
工业数字化、电池与无人机有催化，汽车与停牌标的需回避叙事外推
政策和美股概念风险偏好仍利于智能制造与无人机事件观察；但宁德时代A/H开盘显著弱于各自基准，电池链从条件关注降为回避，秦港股份停牌仍无法执行，汽车链并非普涨。

盘前结论

事实：10月20日AKShare盘中A股3639涨/1778跌、中位数+0.81%；09:44 CST，上证+0.02%、深成指+0.46%、创业板+0.18%，恒指+0.49%、恒生科技+0.93%，但宁德时代A股-8.97%、H股-2.87%。

判断：指数小幅走强仍支持结构交易，但宁德时代A/H双线显著跑输表明盈利增长未获价格确认；电池链转为回避追价，政策催化需选择相对强势分支。

不确定性：AKShare宽度仍是前一交易日盘中快照；09:44开盘行情来自腾讯报价，行业榜末页仍超时。不同来源和时点分别披露，不把实时指数与旧宽度拼成同步统计。

重点个股关注

宁德时代
300750.SZ / 03750.HK
回避
前三季度营收+56.19%、归母利润+31.60%，但三季度利润增速降至14.5%、经营现金流-23.60%。09:44 CST，A股235.85元、-8.97%，H股400港元、-2.87%，均显著弱于各自指数。 filing quote analysis
回避理由：A股触及约-9%、H股同步走弱，而创业板和恒生科技上涨，原先“守住前收并跑赢基准”的确认条件已明确失效。重估条件：A/H分别止跌、成交量收敛并重新跑赢创业板与恒生科技，且利润增速、现金流和竞争压力获得改善证据。风险：禁止把业绩增长直接包装成即时多头信号。
秦港股份
601326.SH / 03369.HK
回避
筹划收购曹妃甸港口资产并配套募资，构成关联交易；A股今日起停牌。最近可核验A股价格为10月20日收盘3.57元、-1.38%。 source
重估条件：复牌并完整披露估值、融资与整合安排后再评估。风险/失效：停牌、关联交易、估值与整合风险使当前不可执行，禁止包装为即时多头。

板块轮动看板

电池 / 新能源车宁德时代A股约跌9%、H股跌2.87%且均弱于基准，价格已否定盘前确认条件；短线回避追价，等待双线止跌。
智能制造 / 机器人智能工厂公示与科技兴商政策提升中期关注度，优先筛选已有订单而非主题追涨。
无人机 / 激光雷达美股概念榜居前，A/H映射需结合公告与开盘反馈，不直接复制海外涨幅。
汽车玻璃 / 港口重组福耀利润承压、秦港停牌，显示事件与盈利质量优先于行业标签。

逻辑链

隔夜输入：道指与小盘股偏强，纳指微跌；美股Top5集中于金融、咨询、生物科技和新兴概念
国内催化：新质生产力、智能工厂与机器人消费应用提供政策线索
市场证据：指数09:44小幅上涨，但宁德时代A股-8.97%、H股-2.87%，电池龙头与基准明显背离
执行：宁德时代降为回避，电池链不追价；停牌重组与利润承压标的继续避免叙事外推

风险雷达

AI信用与高利率

10年期收益率仍约5.12%，资本密集型AI链对融资与现金流更敏感。

油价与地缘反复

Brent盘中冲高后回落至109美元下方，方向反复可能扰动通胀、运输和化工成本。

开盘相对弱势

宁德时代A/H均弱于上涨中的创业板和恒生科技，盈利增长尚未转化为价格确认；AKShare宽度仍为10月20日盘中快照。

停牌与公告执行

关联收购、合同和订单仍有审批、履约、估值与整合风险；停牌标的不具即时可交易性。

数据来源与时间点

政策与公告：国家发展改革委、工信部、巨潮资讯、上交所/HKEX公告索引；市场与国际：AP、WSJ、Investors.com、Reuters；A/H宽度：AKShare 2026-10-20 12:52 CST；开盘指数与宁德时代A/H报价：腾讯行情 2026-10-21 09:44 CST；美股排行：Moomoo GitHub Actions快照 2026-10-21 07:55 CST，对应10月20日现金时段，行业仅Top5（末页超时）、概念Top5完整。增量研究截止2026-10-21 09:46 CST；不同来源与时点已分开披露。

AKShare is an Oct. 20 12:52 CST intraday snapshot; U.S. indexes are official Oct. 20 closes. The different timestamps are not presented as a synchronized comparison.

Keyword Cloud

Positive A-share breadthHK tech pressureCATL earningsNDRC policySmart manufacturingConcept risk appetitePartial industry listSuspension riskTech divergenceDirection-only futures
BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 shows importance, not percentage change.
Major News
Global markets
U.S. indexes diverged as small caps and defensives led
On Oct. 20, the Dow rose 1.02% and the S&P 500 gained 0.28%, while the Nasdaq slipped 0.02%; the Russell 2000 jumped 1.7%. Strong earnings supported the tape, but AI capex and credit concerns still weighed on mega-cap tech. source
Overnight futures
Futures leaned positive as SpaceX and Super Micro lifted AI hardware
An Oct. 21 Asia-morning check showed Dow futures near flat and S&P 500/Nasdaq-100 futures higher. The source did not expose a fully synchronized set of percentages, so only direction is used. source
Domestic policy
NDRC emphasized new productive forces, scenario access and factor reform
The Oct. 20 briefing covered new productive forces, inclusive elderly-care pricing, scenario opening and market-based allocation of production factors. Company orders and price action are still required for validation. source
Industrial policy
MIIT opened the 2026 Excellent Smart Factory list for comment
The Oct. 20-26 consultation provides project-level leads for automation, machine vision, industrial software and equipment renewal, but inclusion does not itself equal incremental revenue. source
Industrial policy
Technology-enabled commerce and humanoid-robot applications received policy detail
MIIT's Oct. 20 briefing created medium-term themes in robotics, retail digitalization and service automation. source
A/H earnings
CATL's earnings grew, but both listings sharply underperformed after the open
Nine-month revenue reached RMB442.14bn and attributable profit RMB64.53bn, up 56.19% and 31.60%, but third-quarter profit growth slowed and operating cash flow fell 23.60%. At 09:44 CST, the A share was RMB235.85, down 8.97%, and the H share HKD400, down 2.87%; ChiNext rose 0.18% and HSTECH 0.93%, confirming sharp negative relative-price feedback. filing quote analysis
A-share compute
Zhimingda disclosed a high-performance-computing module contract
The announcement index shows a RMB49.275m sales contract with a positive 2026 earnings contribution if performed. The full primary filing and a same-timestamp reliable quote were not both retrievable, so the event is listed without a stock card. source
A/H ports
Qinhuangdao Port plans related-party acquisitions and is suspended today
The company plans to buy multiple Caofeidian port stakes and raise supporting funds. Its A share is suspended from the Oct. 21 open for up to ten trading days; it closed Oct. 20 at RMB3.57, down 1.38%, leaving no current execution window. source
A/H shipbuilding
CSSC Offshore & Marine Engineering reported orders above plan
Nine-month new orders were RMB35.799bn, 217.97% of the annual plan, led by container-vessel contracts. Delivery timing, costs and FX remain execution risks. source
A/H autos
Fuyao Glass profit pressure reinforced auto-chain dispersion
A public announcement digest showed nine-month revenue of RMB34.123bn (+2.46%) and attributable profit of RMB6.006bn (-14.97%); the stock was about 0.38% lower on Oct. 20. The official report and same-timestamp close could not both be reread by cutoff, so no card is issued. source
U.S.-to-A/H map
3M and defensives outperformed mega-cap tech, arguing for stock selection
3M raised guidance and benefited from a data-center partnership, while GM fell despite an earnings beat as costs and guidance dominated. A/H automation and auto names therefore need order quality, margins and price feedback together. source

US Overnight Trading Summary

Indexes & futures
Dow outperformed Nasdaq; Asia-morning futures leaned positive
The Dow rose 1.02%, S&P 500 0.28% and Nasdaq slipped 0.02% on Oct. 20. The latest check confirmed Dow futures near flat and S&P/Nasdaq-100 futures higher, without using unsynchronized exact percentages.
Rankings
Industry Top5 and Concept Top5 were positive; Industry Bottom5 was unavailable
Textiles, mortgage finance, consulting, airport services and biotech led industries; lidar, weight-loss drugs, drones, crypto treasury and cancer research led concepts. The industry last-page request timed out, so no stale Bottom5 was reused.
A/H map
Industrial digitalization, batteries and drones have catalysts, but autos and suspended names need restraint
Policy and concept appetite still support event watches in smart manufacturing and drones. CATL's two listings sharply underperformed their benchmarks after the open, moving batteries from conditional watch to avoid; Qinhuangdao Port remains non-executable while suspended, and autos are not a blanket long.

Premarket View

Fact: The Oct. 20 AKShare snapshot showed 3,639 A shares up versus 1,778 down and a +0.81% median. At 09:44 CST, Shanghai was +0.02%, Shenzhen +0.46%, ChiNext +0.18%, HSI +0.49% and HSTECH +0.93%, while CATL A fell 8.97% and H fell 2.87%.

View: Modestly firmer indexes still support selective trades, but CATL's dual-listing underperformance shows earnings growth failed to win price confirmation. Avoid chasing batteries; favor policy themes showing actual relative strength.

Uncertainty: AKShare breadth remains a prior-session intraday snapshot; 09:44 opening quotes are from Tencent, and the industry ranking last page still timed out. Live indexes are not blended with stale breadth as a synchronized statistic.

Stock Focus

CATL
300750.SZ / 03750.HK
Avoid
Nine-month revenue rose 56.19% and attributable profit 31.60%, but third-quarter profit growth slowed to 14.5% and operating cash flow fell 23.60%. At 09:44 CST, A shares were RMB235.85 (-8.97%) and H shares HKD400 (-2.87%), both sharply behind their benchmarks. filing quote analysis
Avoid rationale: A shares touched about -9% and H shares also fell while ChiNext and HSTECH rose, explicitly invalidating the pre-open condition to hold the prior close and outperform benchmarks. Reassessment: both listings stabilize, volume pressure fades and relative strength returns, with better evidence on profit growth, cash flow and competition. Risk: do not present earnings growth as an immediate long signal.
Qinhuangdao Port
601326.SH / 03369.HK
Avoid
The company is planning related-party Caofeidian port acquisitions and supporting financing; its A share is suspended today. The latest verified A-share price was RMB3.57 at the Oct. 20 close, down 1.38%. source
Reassessment: only after resumption and full disclosure of valuation, financing and integration terms. Risk: suspension, related-party, valuation and integration risks make the position non-executable now.

Sector Rotation

Batteries / EVsCATL A fell about 9% and H 2.87%, both behind benchmarks. Price action invalidated the pre-open condition; avoid chasing until both listings stabilize.
Smart manufacturing / roboticsSmart-factory and technology-enabled-commerce policies lift medium-term attention; favor existing orders over theme chasing.
Drones / lidarU.S. concept rankings were strong; A/H mapping still requires filings and opening feedback.
Auto glass / port restructuringFuyao's profit pressure and Qinhuangdao Port's suspension show that event quality matters more than industry labels.

Logic Chain

Overnight input: Dow and small caps led while Nasdaq was flat; U.S. Top5 strength centered on finance, consulting, biotech and emerging concepts
Domestic catalysts: new productive forces, smart factories and humanoid-robot applications
Market evidence: indexes were modestly higher at 09:44, but CATL A -8.97% and H -2.87% showed a major benchmark divergence
Execution: downgrade CATL to avoid and do not chase batteries; keep rejecting bullish extrapolation for suspended or profit-pressured names

Risk Radar

AI credit and high rates

The U.S. 10-year remained near 5.12%, raising sensitivity to financing and cash flow across capital-intensive AI.

Oil and geopolitics

Brent reversed from an intraday spike to below $109, and renewed swings can affect inflation, transport and chemicals.

Opening relative weakness

Both CATL listings lagged rising ChiNext and HSTECH, so earnings growth lacks price confirmation; AKShare breadth remains an Oct. 20 intraday snapshot.

Suspension and execution

Related acquisitions, contracts and orders retain approval, fulfillment, valuation and integration risks; suspended shares are not currently tradable.

Sources & Timing

Policy and filings: NDRC, MIIT, CNINFO and SSE/HKEX announcement indexes. Markets: AP, WSJ, Investors.com and Reuters. A/H breadth: AKShare at 2026-10-20 12:52 CST. Opening indexes and CATL dual-listing quotes: Tencent at 2026-10-21 09:44 CST. U.S. rankings: Moomoo GitHub Actions snapshot at 2026-10-21 07:55 CST for the Oct. 20 cash session; Industry Top5 only (last page timed out), Concept Top5 complete. Incremental research cutoff 2026-10-21 09:46 CST; source and timestamp differences are disclosed separately.

盘前结论

事实：截至07:57 ET，道指、标普500和纳指100期货约涨0.15%、0.27%和0.69%；SPCX与SMCI分别涨7.2%和10.9%，NFLX与AT&T分别跌6.6%和3.5%。

判断：AI盈利证据令服务器、芯片与航天链获得正反馈，开盘基准情景为温和高开但强分化；SPCX、SMCI与DELL只在守住跳空或前收后保留多头观察。

不确定性：Brent仍近110美元，利率与通胀可快速逆转风险偏好；个股盘前量能缺失，且合并讨论不等于确定交易。

重点个股推荐

SpaceXSPCX
盈利正反馈

推荐理由：首次以公众公司身份实现盈利，盘前涨7.2%、明显跑赢指数；卫星、发射与AI基础设施叙事形成多重催化。

触发因素：开盘后守住财报跳空并维持对RKLB、PL和LUNR的相对强势。

风险点：合并讨论尚非确定交易，若上涨主要由交易想象驱动应降级为事件观察；可靠盘前成交量未取得。

Super Micro ComputerSMCI
指引正反馈

推荐理由：季度收入与利润率预测高于华尔街预期，盘前涨10.9%，并带动DELL和HPE同步走强。

触发因素：开盘后守住两位数跳空，且服务器同业继续上行。

风险点：高波动、执行与治理风险仍高；若迅速回补缺口即停止追多，量能数据未可靠取得。

Dell TechnologiesDELL
同业映射强势

推荐理由：受SMCI业绩映射推动盘前涨5.5%，价格反馈强于HPE并跑赢纳指期货。

触发因素：开盘继续跑赢HPE及半导体指数，并保持在前收之上。

风险点：催化来自同业而非DELL自身新指引，容易冲高回落；盘前量能未知，不描述为放量。

板块轮动看板

强势观察

AI服务器、芯片与航天链最强，SPCX和SMCI具备独立财报正反馈，DELL/HPE为板块映射。

事件驱动

META、LRCX、TXN与TSLA盘后财报将决定广告、晶圆设备、模拟芯片与汽车链的下一轮定价。

压力方向

NFLX和AT&T即使有经营亮点仍遭负反馈；Brent近110美元继续压制长久期与运输消费。

验证信号

观察纳指期货能否保持领涨、SPCX/SMCI是否守住跳空，以及Brent能否回落至108美元下方。

逻辑链

新闻事实

SPCX实现首次公众公司盈利，SMCI指引超预期；NFLX利润展望偏弱，AT&T超预期仍下跌。

资产反馈

纳指期货领涨，SPCX与SMCI强势上行；NFLX与AT&T明显下跌，油价维持高位。

板块传导

AI盈利证据修复服务器、芯片与航天风险偏好，但高油价与高利率继续筛选现金流质量。

开盘判断

基准情景为指数温和高开、内部高度分化；只在SPCX/SMCI/DELL守住前收及相对强势时保留多头观察。

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下概率为基于一致预期、历史surprise、近期指引与行业景气的判断，不是确定事实。

Meta PlatformsMETA
beat概率：中

一致预期约收入633.4亿美元、调整后EPS 6.53美元。过去8次约7次EPS beat，但上一季度EPS 6.18美元低于7.19美元预期；Muse、AI资本开支和广告变现决定反馈。

Lam ResearchLRCX
beat概率：高

一致预期约EPS 2.18美元、收入81.3亿美元；上一季度EPS 1.47美元高于1.36美元预期。存储与先进制程设备景气支撑，但高预期与出口限制是风险。

Texas InstrumentsTXN
beat概率：中

一致预期约EPS 2.43美元、收入59.4亿美元；过去8次约6次EPS beat，上一季度2.14美元高于1.91美元预期。汽车与工业复苏仍不均衡。

TeslaTSLA
beat概率：低

FactSet一致预期收入281亿美元、调整后EPS 0.45美元，收入同比近乎持平且EPS低于上年0.50美元；过去8次仅约4次beat。汽车毛利率、资本开支及机器人出租车进展更关键。

风险雷达

盘后财报跳空

META、LRCX、TXN与TSLA同晚披露，收入、利润率或指引偏差可能放大科技波动。

AI反弹持续性

SMCI与SPCX大涨可能造成拥挤；CRWV的债务与融资担忧未因单日反弹消失。

油价与再加息

Brent近110美元且通胀扩散，可能推高长债收益率并压低成长股估值。

合并叙事风险

SpaceX与Tesla合并只是讨论，协同、治理、估值与少数股东利益均未确定。

行情与量能限制

期指与大宗商品来自07:57 ET延迟快照；个股可靠盘前量能不可得，不把未知写成放量。

Premarket Conclusion

Fact: At 07:57 ET, Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures were up 0.15%, 0.27% and 0.69%; SPCX and SMCI rose 7.2% and 10.9%, while NFLX and AT&T fell 6.6% and 3.5%.

View: AI profitability evidence is getting positive feedback across servers, chips and space. Base case is a modestly higher but highly dispersed open; keep SPCX, SMCI and DELL on the long watch only if they hold their gaps or prior closes.

Uncertainty: Brent remains near $110, so rates and inflation can reverse risk appetite quickly. Premarket volume is unavailable, and merger discussion is not a definitive transaction.

Stocks to Watch

SpaceXSPCX
Positive earnings feedback

Rationale: The company posted its first profit as a public company and rose 7.2% premarket, materially outperforming the indexes; space and AI infrastructure offer multiple catalysts.

Trigger: Hold the earnings gap and relative strength versus RKLB, PL and LUNR after the open.

Risk: Merger talk is not definitive; if the move is mainly deal speculation, downgrade to event watch. Reliable volume was unavailable.

Super Micro ComputerSMCI
Positive guidance feedback

Rationale: Revenue and margin guidance topped expectations, sending shares up 10.9% and lifting DELL and HPE.

Trigger: Hold the double-digit gap after the open while server peers remain positive.

Risk: Volatility, execution and governance risks remain high; stop chasing if the gap fills quickly. Reliable volume was unavailable.

Dell TechnologiesDELL
Strong peer read-through

Rationale: The stock rose 5.5% on the SMCI read-through, stronger than HPE and well ahead of Nasdaq futures.

Trigger: Keep outperforming HPE and the semiconductor index while holding above the prior close.

Risk: The catalyst is a peer result rather than fresh DELL guidance, so the move can fade; unknown volume is not labeled heavy.

After-hours Earnings Beat Probability

These probabilities are judgments based on consensus, historical surprises, recent guidance and industry conditions—not facts.

Meta PlatformsMETA
beat probability: medium

Consensus is about $63.34B revenue and $6.53 adjusted EPS. It beat EPS in roughly seven of eight reports, but last quarter's $6.18 missed $7.19; Muse, AI capex and ad monetization drive the reaction.

Lam ResearchLRCX
beat probability: high

Consensus is about $2.18 EPS and $8.13B revenue; last quarter's $1.47 beat $1.36. Memory and advanced-node demand support the case, while high expectations and export limits are risks.

Texas InstrumentsTXN
beat probability: medium

Consensus is about $2.43 EPS and $5.94B revenue; it beat EPS in roughly six of eight reports, and last quarter's $2.14 topped $1.91. Auto and industrial recovery remains uneven.

TeslaTSLA
beat probability: low

FactSet consensus calls for $28.1B revenue and $0.45 adjusted EPS, with revenue roughly flat and EPS below last year's $0.50; it beat in only about four of eight reports. Auto margin, capex and robotaxi progress matter more.

Risk Radar

After-hours gap risk

META, LRCX, TXN and TSLA report together; any revenue, margin or guidance miss can amplify tech volatility.

Durability of the AI rebound

Sharp moves in SMCI and SPCX can become crowded; CRWV's leverage and funding concerns did not vanish.

Oil and another rate hike

Brent near $110 and broader inflation can lift long yields and compress growth multiples.

Merger-narrative risk

A SpaceX-Tesla combination is only discussion; synergy, governance, valuation and minority outcomes are uncertain.
